page.layout: One printed page, one text column of running text with centred headings, two small genealogical tables set in the column, and no notes in the margins. Running head at top centre; page number at top right; page number at foot centre below the text.

main_text.p: eundum: Jacob, pronepos, tertium: Iofeph adnepos, quartum: Ephraim, atnepos, quintum. Nuptiæ autem inter afcendentes & defcendentes in infinitum funt prohibitæ.

Sed quoad Collaterales, valde differunt jus civile & canonicum. Nam de jure civili in linea Collaterali æquali vel inæquali tot funt gradus, quot funt perfonæ ftipite dempto. De jure autem Canonico fequentes obferventur Regulæ.
main_text.head: Prima Regula.
main_text.p: Quoto gradu altera perfona in linea æquali collateralium diftat à communi ftipite, eodem gradu inter fe diftant: ut,

Achilles diftat à ftipite fecundo gradu: Ergo Achilles & Ajax inter fe, fecundo gradu diftant, per hanc primam Regulam. Nunc autem prohibitum eft matrimonium inter collaterales ufq; ad quartum gradum inclufive, id eft, ut quartus gradus includatur, & non licet tibi ducere uxorem, quæ tibi in quarto gradu confanguinitatis eft conjuncta, inquit Schneidewinus.
main_text.head: Secunda Regula.
main_text.p: Quoto gradu lineæ inæqualis collateralium, remotior diftat à ftipite, eodem gradu à fe quoque diftant: ut,
Rebecca diftat tertio gradu à ftipite, ideo & ab Ifaac diftat tertio gradu, per hanc fecundam Regulam

page.notes: Page number "505" printed top right; the running head "IURIS." is at top centre, with a fragment of a dash/ornament before it.
